title: Supreme Court Grants Journalist Absolute Protection from Arrest Over Ayodhya Temple Theft Reporting
detail: India's Supreme Court issued a landmark press freedom ruling, granting absolute protection from arrest to a journalist who reported on allegations of theft at the Ayodhya Ram temple. The ruling is seen as a significant affirmation of journalistic protections for reporting on sensitive religious and political matters.

media.caption: Supreme Court grants journalist protection over Ayodhya temple theft reporting
